text:
Which statement about the electrolysis of concentrated aqueous sodium chloride is correct?
A
Chlorine is produced at the positive electrode.
B
Hydrogen is produced at the positive electrode.
C
Oxygen is produced at the negative electrode.
D
Sodium is produced at the negative electrode.

options.label: A
options.text: Chlorine is produced at the positive electrode.

options.label: B
options.text: Hydrogen is produced at the positive electrode.

options.label: C
options.text: Oxygen is produced at the negative electrode.

options.label: D
options.text: Sodium is produced at the negative electrode.
